source_authority.note: This is a detached replication of the frozen external comparator arm, NOT the full preregistered BDC court. Do not change frozen source/prereg/comparator/thresholds.

external_comparator.method: Source generator was fetched at exact git blob SHA and executed; source mode/mtime normalization, Python tarfile PAX TarInfo uid=gid=0, solid Zstd CLI -19, decode/extract, compare full tree SHA. Two workloads over three independent loops.
external_comparator.runtime: Python 3.13.5; installed Zstd CLI v1.5.7; repository Python zstandard/BDC sibling not run.
external_comparator.interpretation: This controls local same-input Zstd-19 byte fingerprint drift for two original fixed workloads, not Zstd 1.5.7 checksum-pinned upstream tarball provenance or an exact-source hosted run. No BDC archive candidate was produced.

held_out_semantics.experimental_mutations: Held-out modifications preserving frozen path+content tree SHA: chown a Boundary file to uid=4242/gid=4343; separately set user.cmpct_evidence_probe xattr.
held_out_semantics.owner_result: Both original and owner-mutated source generate bit-identical solid tar+Zstd-19, yet extracted owner differs from mutated source.
held_out_semantics.xattr_result: Both original and xattr-mutated source generate bit-identical solid tar+Zstd-19, yet extracted xattr absent.
held_out_semantics.causal_mechanism: Frozen comparator tar writer explicitly forces uid/gid zero, does not serialize xattrs; hostile.tree_hash covers paths+content bytes only; FS.capture_filesystem_manifest and _xattrs preserve owners and xattrs. This is an out-of-domain comparator semantics limitation, NOT a failing result on the two frozen workloads.
held_out_semantics.scope: Held-out semantic perturbation not included in the frozen prereg; no benchmark/workload/comparator threshold changed.

evaluator_attestation.observation: Frozen run().passed omits matches_historical_current_fingerprint_bytes; extra independent validator needed to prevent external fingerprint false green.
evaluator_attestation.current_local_detached_validator_tests: 21/21 PASS, mutations rejecting incomplete/mismatched comparator receipts.
evaluator_attestation.boundary: Independent schema/receipt audit is not authenticated CI provenance, and is not scientific BDC promotion.

discovery_decision.metadata_generalization_question: External comparator preserves path+byte identities, but owner/xattr semantic parity is false for held-out mutated sources.
discovery_decision.next: Execute frozen BDC coordered court on a legitimate exact-source hosted route, with mandatory independent per-row historical Zstd-19 fingerprint gate. Preserve original frozen workload semantics; any future held-out full-fidelity comparator must normalize and/or serialize metadata symmetrically.
